title: The Grey Left Where It Lay

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The yard carried the names from door to door and set them down where the speaking stopped. The grey was left where it lay and burnt the next morning, and nobody called the two the same thing. A year went out with its figure unsigned and came back wearing the same face, and the fire kept four pulls and wanted a fifth.
epigraph.attribution: A Low Kiln saying, kept through the Five

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and ninety-three to three hundred and ninety-five days, six months and two hundred and thirteen to two hundred and fifteen days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone; no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest toward a later discovery. No departure from the boy's eyes: House Silt is entered only as an errand seen from the basket's low angle, the Debt Loft and the back room remain a sound and a shape from below, and no Court room is brought under the roof. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put and not made again, still a finding and not a placing; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter lives the last two of the Five and the turn of the year: the Remembering, when the names of the dead go from house to house and the Vail house keeps its own quiet and does not say the one name; the Last Day, when bread is baked and the grey is left in the corners; and Ilmen 1 of Y.H. 814, Firstday, when the yard burns the grey and calls it dealt with and the household goes back to its grammar as though nothing had turned. The year's first arithmetic waits at Ilmen 10 (Day 404) and is not brought early.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Names Going Up the Yard
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{393}{the Remembering, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the fourth of the Five under the Vail kiln-house roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, the hand laid down against the fold on answer 360 and the count exact at 392 carried in from Chapter 113. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, the twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, the unforged collector sentence at the kindling, the uncalled tile debt). Walk-ons only: unnamed neighbours who pass the names of the dead from house to house along the Clay Yard. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Kindling, Weighing or the Long Night crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the Remembering is not called an opening, a payment or a boundary, and no tend-day is set against it. Dramatic purpose: the names of the dead go up the yard from door to door while the Vail house keeps its own quiet and does not say the one name, so Garl's name stays unspoken its three hundred and ninety-third day and no whole return is announced for him under this roof, and the clean voice's missing name from Weighing stays on the gap tray and is not filled (T080/T090, T009/T013 advanced, not paid). Dessa's name goes among the others in the yard but is not spoken under this roof, is never spoken to the boy, and her number is not given; the mercy-lie stands as a fact nobody can correct. The surgeon takes the body in its old order, knows that a face composed by cold is not composure, that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core, and that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, and the quarrel goes on without verdict. Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw where another woman would say I, turns them with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger above the unread charcoal and her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs untouched because a holy day is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule with no eighth made due. She carries him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, and sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft. The carried fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed and its fifth unpaid three hundred and ninety-three days; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell, four, four and a gap, and the gap is folded into nothing. Answer 361 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer; count 393 exact, six months and two hundred and thirteen days told by nobody. The last image is the fold found where put under the crust's hair-lifted corner, the name that did not come under the roof kept on its own place with a finger between it and every other gap, and the hand laid flat on the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking.

scenes.title: The Tin Above the Empty Bed
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the Remembering afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 362 and the count at 393 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours at the yard well and in House Silt; Tarn and Jorra Vail not on stage this day; no collector, officer, Berr, Hessa, Ilva, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards. Dramatic purpose: an errand to House Silt three doors down lets the pewter tin above the empty bed be seen from the basket's low angle with its pale fold and bright thumb-rub on the lid and not opened, while the name under the sieve-wire scar and the number in a thumb stay unspoken and the mercy-lie stands unchanged as a fact nobody can correct (T089, T008, T023 held — the sixth note and Alda's tin stay shut and are not paid again; T020 expressly not paid again). The boy does not turn the visit into a quest, does not open the tin, does not speak her name or number and does not make a cause of the fold; what he keeps is the finding that a thing left where it lies is still kept, entered nowhere (T009/T013/T092). Sella sets the basket just inside the finger's-width-open door at the edge of the light away from every open slate, gives no instruction to the basket, takes what she came for and goes, and the scrubbing neighbour at her cloth does not look up at the writing or the tin. In the afternoon out in the Clay Yard the yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back; the three coverings and the river's winter skin stay weather and coverings entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the keeping at the fold is found where put and is still a finding, not a placing, habit, way, sign, gift, payment or rule (T097/T060/T086, T083/T085, T098). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather at the well: a number goes from a fist toward the pail and arrives nowhere, a woman asks what the day's work cost and is sent to the pot, and the boy files the order of reaching without making a tenth record-first hand of any of them (T077, T080, T090 held). The file comes out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, and every gap is left a gap: the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold, the told bell's gap, the silence after Weighing's name, the place a Remembering name did not fill, Tarn's stopped ear-sentence, Jorra's promise and Garl's unforged collector sentence. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the Drawing's small flat knock outside them, and no story gap made a seventh hearing (T061/T082, T078, T081). Answer 362 filed; count 393 exact. The last image is the pewter tin's pale fold seen once from the low angle and left above the empty bed with its lid thumb-bright and unlifted, the hand coming down on the fold under the Vail roof with no name carried across either threshold.

scenes.title: The Grey Left Where It Lay
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{394}{the Last Day, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the fifth and last of the Five, then the morning's baking and the yard going around its corners, with answer 363. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours baking bread and a neighbour who says the grey will be dealt with in the morning. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards; the four old directions stand where put and do not repeat. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from the Remembering crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the Last Day is not made a boundary or a payment. Dramatic purpose: bread is baked under the Vail roof and the grey Ash at the Vail corner and along the skirting board is left where it lies, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang coming up where no broom has gone in two years; a neighbour calls the grey dealt with because it will be burnt in the morning, and Sella does not say it, so the called-gone grey and the left-in-place ridge stand on separate places with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085 advanced, not paid). The widow's mark is touched at no hour, for baking bread is not an opening and a holy day has not made an eighth due; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079). The surgeon takes the body in its old order and knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, and gets none of the three. No third crust enters the fold; the spent crust stands two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and the wool in the empty place is found where put and not made again (T060/T086, T097). Sella turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and gives no figure and no handful, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, keeps her finger above the charcoal, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and tells the coals it is the thaw where another woman would say I. The carried fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed and its fifth unpaid three hundred and ninety-four days (T088). The heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell and the three counts in three places stay three (T078, T061/T082). Answer 363 filed; count 394 exact, six months and two hundred and fourteen days told by nobody. The last image is the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey beside it unswept under the last of the year's light, a loaf set aside without a figure, and the boy's hand coming down flat on the fold with the thread frozen and unwiped.

scenes.title: A Term Already Ended
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the Last Day afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the fifth and final holy day, with answer 364 and the count at 394 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the cold damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier shifting a hare across his shoulders, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders wanting the thaw early and late. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice; the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness and the well-saying at four shapings, and none is added to on a holy day (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T080 held). Dramatic purpose: Tarn stands at a term already ended with the loan uncalled, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure — a term ending is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom — while Jorra's promise under the wheel-shed is neither given nor withdrawn and the equality under the roof moves no further (T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid). Six pieces stand in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt; the small knife lies at the very edge of its sill and his hand goes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, and he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, cutting, counting and spending nothing. The ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it comes to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, no figure and no name, and a want he does not voice for a slate with his own name and no mark against it stays his. Chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist giving back the little light, his stroke goes over the shallow bright flagstones without the half-check; the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again (T061/T082, T006). Costs arrive as directions: the hare to the weather which carried the snow and can carry the price, the cracked jar to a pot that says nothing, *Yes, house* to the kindling woman and to both fence-menders while the late is kept because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument finds a foot (T077, T058/T079). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; three or more men unnamed have gone low into the back room before first grey and he gives no name and does not say the room is cold; dusty forearms and clean are kept on one tray and parted as clot from vessel; he speaks to the wheel before any person — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — tells a pot *You'll do*, knows the full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, moving the tongue a hair's breadth and coming out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word covering both mercies (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed; the boy does not let Tarn's stopped sentence, Jorra's ungiven promise and the gap where a Remembering name did not stand stand up together and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082, T080). Answer 364 filed; count 394 exact. The last image is Jorra's bent finger coming out of the cold damper without the extra holding, Tarn's hand going up over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and the fifth of the Five going out without a boundary drawn or an eighth opening made due.

scenes.title: The Morning the Grey Was Burnt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{395}{Ilmen 1, Y.H. 814, Firstday}: the small hours opening the new year, then the morning's burning of the grey and the household going back to its grammar, with answer 365. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: the neighbours who burn the Ash in the morning and the neighbour who calls it dealt with. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy; the year's first arithmetic waits at Ilmen 10 (Day 404) and is not brought into a morning that has not earned it. New day, new date, no recap: the Last Day's left-in-place ridge stays where it was put and its called-gone likeness stays on its own place; the turn of the year is not made a boundary, a signing, a payer or a doctrine, and the reset of the tend on Ilmen 1 does not stand up as a signature (T015/T041/T047, T009/T013/T092 advanced, not paid). Dramatic purpose: the yard burns the morning's grey and calls it dealt with while Sella says nothing and the boy keeps the called-gone beside the left-in-place with a finger between, so a thing called finished is still not finished and the Ash's memory is not spent or explained (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket at the going of the light of the old year's last holy day and again in the new morning, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger above the charcoal, moves her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. The widow's mark hangs where it hung and is not touched — the burning of another house's grey by the yard is not an opening and no eighth is due on the Firstday of a new year — and seven openings in seven months stay seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). She carries him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, and at each going of the light sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, putting the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adding no second fold (T097/T060/T086). The surgeon takes the body in its old order; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle and gets none of the three, and the quarrel is not settled by a year turning. The carried fire comes from a payer nobody under the roof names or prices and answers four low pulls with the fifth still missing, its payer unnamed and its fifth unpaid three hundred and ninety-five days, and the fire that warms the house has no name on its giver (T088, advancing toward the far-off naming of the Hearth as a wound). Answer 365 filed; count 395 exact, six months and two hundred and fifteen days told by nobody. The last image is the yard's thin skin of grey gone from the corners it was swept toward while the finer grey beside the clean dark line at the Vail corner stays where a hand left it, and the boy's hand laid flat on the fold under the roof with the year turned and nothing signed.

scenes.title: Twelve Behind One Unsigned Figure
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 1 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 366 and the count at 395 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours settling into the ordinary grammar of the new year. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the four old directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). Dramatic purpose: the household goes back to its grammar as though nothing had turned, and the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 are carried across into Y.H. 814 unchanged behind one unsigned figure — twelve are twelve and not one account, the figure read is still not the figure paid, no signature stands on the space and no doctrine comes out of twelve — while the reset of the tend supplies no payer to the old twelve or to a new one (T015/T041/T047 advanced, not paid). The boy does not lay his twelve old findings across a new figure to make a row come out even and does not bring Ilmen 10's first arithmetic into a day that has not earned it. The file comes out on the towel as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, and he goes over the field by the place of each thing and leaves every gap a gap: the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell's gap, the silence after Weighing's name, the place the Remembering did not fill, the neighbour's called-gone grey and the left-in-place ridge on two places, Tarn's stopped ear-sentence at the very end of a term already ended, Jorra's promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn, and Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch. Nine record-first hands stand with no tenth: Hessa's eighth with her slate up the road unread, Ilva's ninth with her strip in her sleeve, Berr's twice-wiped thumb with the twelve true subtractions locked in his box up the clay road and the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing, the Drawing collector's ordinary hand, the Kindling collector's ordinary hand on its own tray with the belief that will one day be remembered against him, the neat dark hand, Marra's, and the finger beneath the shelf; the clean-voice speaker of Weighing stays taken out of his own sentences on a place of his own and is not made a tenth hand (T080/T090, T100, T097 held). Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them; nine stoppings keep no tenth, seven openings in seven months keep no eighth, the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the four Ash and Slate directions held apart, the green a colour and the foundling a shape with no eighth of either, the cold foot uncured and unnamed and the second chill's cause withheld — every one advanced and none paid (T061/T082, T036/T076, T058/T079, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T080, T050/T051, T033/T034, T093/T094/T096, T012). The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note of water over water under the winter skin (the inch is not a reach), takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the covering, lets it go as the note ended — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Answer 366 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and it costs him nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; under it, louder, the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle and gets none of the three. Count 395 exact, six months and two hundred and fifteen days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number; nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended. The last image is the hand flat on the fold on answer 366, the crust's corner standing a hair off the wool, the thread frozen and unwiped, the carried fire breathing four below the floor with its fifth unsupplied, and the river keeping its note under the winter skin beyond the finger's-width door while the new year's first arithmetic waits nine mornings off and is not brought.
